                if line != "":
                    seen.add(line)

    # Read events, preserving line content.
    with open(events_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        data = f.read()
    parts = data.split("\n")
    if parts and parts[-1] == "":
        parts.pop()  # trailing newline produces an empty final piece

    new_lines = []
    new_ids = []
    skipped = 0
    for raw in parts:
        line = raw[:-1] if raw.endswith("\r") else raw
        event_id = line.split(",", 1)[0]
        if event_id in seen:
            skipped += 1

    sys.stdout.write("new: %d, skipped: %d\n" % (len(new_ids), skipped))
